check: Treatment and outcome are clearly defined
why_it_matters: DRLearner estimates the effect of a specific intervention.

check: All X and W variables are pre-treatment
why_it_matters: Post-treatment variables can distort the estimand.
Double robustness does not fix omitted confounding.
Inverse-propensity corrections become unstable near zero or one.
Bad propensity estimates can create poor correction terms.

check: Outcome models by treatment arm are inspected
why_it_matters: The pseudo-outcome relies heavily on potential-outcome predictions.

check: Pseudo-outcome tails and weights are checked
why_it_matters: Large correction weights can dominate the final model.
A linear final model and a forest final model tell different stories.

check: CATE ranking is validated where possible
why_it_matters: Treatment targeting depends on ranking, not only ATE accuracy.
